label: Esse = essence puts existence in the nature, from exercise in it and the act-fact link
description: Factorization of the unconditional bridge 565ccd6c (the ESSENCE_3 to ESSENCE_5 bridge of the essentialist B6 route) into the act-fact link and exercise in the nature. The link is satisfiable with each essentialist bundle (controls, models kantAquinas and conditionalIdentity, with distinct esse principles), and no substantive objection to it is identified among views that accept an act of being. Given the link, exercise in the nature is equivalent to 565ccd6c (controls, law 15): the factorization restates the bridge at the level of the act and separates out the link; it does not narrow the bridge's content. Existence-conditional essences, the link and exercise in the nature are jointly inconsistent at a representably absent identity being (controls, law 6). Not a transcription: neither premise mentions existence in a nature. Uses propositional and function extensionality. Each premise is needed (controls, factorization omissions 1-2). Establishes no premise.
